core.scope: kernel_optimizer Python sources and role prompts at worker entry

goal.T: Minimize first-token latency for the source's interactive workload (batch 1, prompt 256 tokens, full greedy generation of 32 new tokens), preserving the source model, inputs, completion semantics and full quality requirements.
goal.D: Maximize decode_tokens_per_second for the same interactive Qwen3-4B workload: batch 1, prompt 256 tokens, complete greedy generation of 32 new tokens. Retain the original model, inputs, BF16/SDPA/noTF32 policies, full logits tolerance, exact tokens, state lifetimes and both completion boundaries. Decode throughput counts the 31 post-first-token steps; prefill and all 32 tokens remain required. TTFT and end-to-end metrics remain diagnostics. No new quality or performance constraints.

T: Greedy argmax decoding over exactly new_tokens=32 steps with EOS early stopping disabled by the explicit decode loop; the full 32-token sequence must be produced every invocation (qwen_inference.py:25-33; request.json note on input construction: 'Generation length is fixed at new_tokens=32; EOS early stopping is disabled by the explicit loop').

The workload shape is the source's infer() structure: one prefill forward over the full 256-token prompt with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1, first token from argmax of last-position logits, then 31 single-token decode steps reusing past_key_values with logits_to_keep=1 (qwen_inference.py:18-32).

ttft_ms is measured at the source's actual completion boundary: perf_counter_ns around prefill forward + argmax terminated by an explicit torch.cuda.synchronize() ('explicit first-token-ready boundary'); decode timing starts only after that boundary (qwen_inference.py:16-24; request.json note: 'ttft_ms is measured inside infer() ... terminated by torch.cuda.synchronize()').

The model must be Qwen3ForCausalLM loaded from the frozen assets path (revision directory 1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c) in bfloat16 with attn_implementation='sdpa', eval mode, local_files_only=True (qwen_inference.py:49; request.json model/precision policy note); architecture, precision, attention implementation and weights are unchanged.

Numerical policy from common.configure(): torch.set_num_threads(4), set_num_interop_threads(1), torch.manual_seed(20261020), matmul and cudnn TF32 disabled, float32_matmul_precision 'highest', cudnn.benchmark False (common.py:34-42; request.json note).

Inputs are constructed from the workloads.json qwen_inference.prompt via the tokenizer's chat template with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False, encoded without special tokens, repeated/truncated to exactly prompt_tokens=256 and tiled to batch=1, resident on the worker device (qwen_inference.py:55-58; request.json input-construction note).

Source-defined correctness must hold per invocation: a teacher-forced replay must satisfy torch.equal(actual_tokens, tokens) for the full 32 greedy tokens, per-step last-position logits must match the greedy capture within logits_atol=logits_rtol=0.02, and a +1 corrupted reference must be rejected; these relational checks are implemented in observe() outside timed run() (qwen_inference.py:59-64; workloads.json qwen_inference.correctness; request.json quality).

The timed region contains only one clean infer() call; model/tokenizer loading, tokenization, reference construction, teacher-forced verification, negative control, torch.save, warmup, repeats and statistical reduction are outside it (request.json notes on harness vs measured invocation).

Workload dimensions (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, new_tokens=32) are read from request['workload'] in prepare(); they are frozen for this run but a separately validated variant may supply different values through the same adapter (request.json workload; adapter contract).

Single-process, single-GPU task: the adapter uses context['device'] after worker device binding instead of choosing a physical GPU, initializes no process group, and performs no communication (request.json note: single-process single-GPU task, no distributed backend, no communication collector fields required).
D: Greedy argmax decoding over exactly new_tokens=32 steps with EOS early stopping disabled by the explicit decode loop; the full 32-token sequence must be produced every invocation (qwen_inference.py:25-33; request.json note: 'Generation length is fixed at new_tokens=32; EOS early stopping is disabled by the explicit loop').

The workload shape is the source's infer() structure, unchanged by this goal variant: one prefill forward over the full prompt_tokens=256 prompt at batch=1 with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1, first token from argmax of last-position logits, then 31 single-token decode steps reusing past_key_values with logits_to_keep=1, yielding exactly 32 new tokens (qwen_inference.py:18-32; request.json workload: id 'interactive', batch 1, prompt_tokens 256, new_tokens 32).

The objective is decode_tokens_per_second with direction maximize (unit tokens/s; request.json goal and objective): the source's decode-phase throughput batch * (new_tokens - 1) * 1e9 / (end - first), i.e. the 31 post-first-token decode steps at batch=1 divided by the decode window (qwen_inference.py:39; adapter.py:97). Prefill and complete greedy generation of all 32 tokens remain required work in every invocation; the variant changes only which phase is scored, never the work performed or its order.

decode_tokens_per_second is measured inside the single infer() invocation between the source's two retained completion boundaries: the decode window opens at the explicit first-token-ready boundary, the torch.cuda.synchronize() terminating prefill forward + argmax (qwen_inference.py:16-24; adapter.py:78), and closes at the final torch.cuda.synchronize() after the last cached decode step (qwen_inference.py:34-35; adapter.py:90-91); both boundaries are kept exactly as in source and no other timing points are introduced.

ttft_ms remains measured at the source's explicit first-token-ready boundary and end_to_end_ms over the whole invocation (qwen_inference.py:37-40), but for this variant they are diagnostics only: the frozen adapter's metrics() records them per sample alongside decode_ms, generated_tokens_per_second, wall-clock derived throughput and peak_allocated_bytes (adapter.py:192-218), and none of these is an objective or a constraint for this request (request.json goal: 'TTFT and end-to-end metrics remain diagnostics'; request.json note: peak_allocated_bytes and ttft_ms are recorded per sample but are not objectives or constraints).

The model must be Qwen3ForCausalLM loaded from the frozen assets path /root/autodl-tmp/c3-qwen3-4b-operator-goals/assets/Qwen3-4B/1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c (revision directory 1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c, 3 safetensors shards plus tokenizer files) in bfloat16 with attn_implementation='sdpa', eval mode, local_files_only=True (qwen_inference.py:49; request.json model/precision policy note); architecture, precision, attention implementation and weights are unchanged.

Numerical policy from common.configure(): torch.set_num_threads(4), set_num_interop_threads(1), torch.manual_seed(20261020), matmul and cudnn TF32 disabled, float32_matmul_precision 'highest', cudnn.benchmark False (common.py:34-42; adapter.py:26, 29-40; request.json note).

Inputs are constructed from the workloads.json qwen_inference.prompt via the tokenizer's chat template with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False, encoded without special tokens, repeated/truncated to exactly prompt_tokens=256 and tiled to batch=1, resident on the worker device (qwen_inference.py:55-58; request.json input-construction note).

Source-defined correctness must hold per invocation at the full original tolerance: a teacher-forced replay must satisfy torch.equal(actual_tokens, tokens) for all 32 greedy tokens, per-step last-position logits must match the greedy capture within logits_atol=logits_rtol=0.02 (atol=rtol=0.02, require_exact_greedy_tokens=true), and a +1 corrupted reference must be rejected; these relational checks run in observe() outside timed run() and raise on violation (qwen_inference.py:59-64; workloads.json qwen_inference.correctness; adapter.py:154-189; request.json quality).

The timed region contains only one clean infer() call on the 'interactive' workload: model/tokenizer loading, tokenization, reference construction (capture=True / teacher-forced runs), close_check/negative_check/torch.equal verification, torch.save of reference tensors, warmup (2), statistical repeats (5) and median reduction via common.summarize() are outside it (request.json notes on harness vs measured invocation; common.py:66-71).

State lifetimes are unchanged: prepare(context, request) runs outside timing, applying the numerical policy with torch.cuda.set_device(context['device']), loading the tokenizer and Qwen3ForCausalLM from request['assets'].assets onto context['device'], and building inputs to request['workload'] dimensions kept in state; reset(state) only drops quality-mode capture references and synchronizes without touching the allocator; run(state) executes the entire workload under torch.inference_mode() with identical execution semantics and identical work in 'quality' capture and 'measure'/'profile' timing modes (set_mode); observe(state, result) reruns the teacher-forced capture and relational checks outside the timer (adapter.py:103-132, 135-142, 144-151, 154-189).

Workload dimensions (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, new_tokens=32) are read from request['workload'] in prepare()/run() and never embedded as constants (adapter.py:107, 116-122, 147), so the frozen, unmodified evaluator serves this goal variant: run() performs the full prefill + 32-token generation regardless of the scored metric and returns the source's internal phase timings, and metrics() exposes decode_tokens_per_second from that internal decode-window timing of the same single invocation (adapter.py:144-151, 192-218); no adapter code is generated or changed for this variant.

No new quality or performance constraints are introduced: request.json objective.constraints is empty, the source 'interactive' workload row attaches no constraints, required_observations is empty, and quality stays exactly atol=rtol=0.02 with logits_atol=logits_rtol=0.02 and require_exact_greedy_tokens=true (request.json objective, workload, quality); nothing in this variant adds thresholds, baseline ratios or loosened accuracy.

Single-process, single-GPU task: the adapter uses context['device'] after worker device binding instead of choosing a physical GPU, initializes no process group, and performs no communication (request.json note: single-process single-GPU task, no distributed backend, no communication collector fields required).

deployment_override.scope: Only device selection in memory; frozen requests and pointers unchanged.

scope: Fixed previously accepted versions under their own original contracts. Same current core, source bytes and adapter. No cross-contract imports, new candidate search, formal acceptance or prompt adoption. No new API call is needed for fixed execution. All original five samples per endpoint retained; separate baseline under each contract, interleaved reverse order. No new trace collection or reference copies.
